name: labs/ap--__python-oceanoptics
title: Ocean Optics QE65000/QE65Pro TEC
intro: Ocean Optics QE65000/QE65Pro TEC, adapted from ap--/python-oceanoptics. It reads `tec_temperature`, `pcb_temperature`, `heatsink_temperature`, `tec_enabled` and 1 more; sets `setpoint`; runs `set_temperature` and `tec_safe_off`. `set_temperature`: set the target temperature of a thermal zone and optionally wait for the zone to reach the setpoint within a declared tolerance. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
